svg.text: Cut a 1,200 x 1,200 mm blank with the flutes running up the panel

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rout a flat-bottomed groove 13.6 mm wide at 600 mm on the back face, down to the front skin

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hot-punch four 8 mm holes 12.5 mm from each side edge at 125, 175, 1,025, 1,075 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hot-punch five 40 mm holes per leaf at 350 mm up, 100 mm apart

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Heat-seal every cut edge, both groove shoulders and ends

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print face is the front: it faces the patient; the groove faces the aisle

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: folds 60 deg toward the front and 30 deg either way without a crack
